signal_text: Apple introduced Apple Intelligence features at WWDC 2024 and said the system would be integrated across its platforms.
Apple reported fiscal third-quarter 2024 revenue of $85.8 billion and diluted earnings per share of $1.40.
Amazon completed its planned $4 billion investment in Anthropic and identified AWS as Anthropic's primary cloud provider.
Amazon's 2024 economic impact report described continued investment in infrastructure, communities, and job creation across the United States.
Broadcom announced the completion of its VMware acquisition and described VMware as part of its infrastructure-software portfolio.
Broadcom reported quarterly results and highlighted growth in its semiconductor and infrastructure-software businesses.
Microsoft announced a multi-year investment in UK artificial-intelligence infrastructure and skills development.
Microsoft reported fiscal fourth-quarter 2024 revenue of $64.7 billion and discussed continued cloud and AI demand.
Walmart announced plans to build or convert more than 150 stores and remodel existing stores over five years.
Walmart said US store managers would receive annual Walmart stock grants of up to $20,000 beginning with the new fiscal year.
Costco reported quarterly results and continued to describe membership renewal and comparable-sales performance as key operating indicators.
Costco opened additional warehouse locations during fiscal 2024 as part of its continuing warehouse expansion program.
Target reported second-quarter 2024 results and maintained its full-year comparable-sales outlook.
Target continued its store-remodeling and supply-chain investment program to improve guest fulfillment and shopping experience.
Lowe's reported fiscal second-quarter 2024 results and discussed demand trends across home-improvement categories.
Lowe's announced additional associate training and professional-development initiatives for its retail workforce.
Caterpillar announced a $90 million investment in Texas to expand and modernize manufacturing capacity.
Caterpillar introduced autonomous hauling technology at a quarry as part of its focus on customer productivity.
3M continued its portfolio transformation following the separation of its healthcare business into Solventum.
3M reported quarterly results and provided management commentary on demand, restructuring, and portfolio actions.
Deere reported fiscal third-quarter 2024 results and discussed lower production-and-precision-agriculture demand.
Deere continued promoting precision-agriculture and autonomy capabilities as operational levers for farm customers.
